# harness-sdk

> Build an agent harness and control it end-to-end. Open-source SDK for production AI agents in Python & TypeScript - any model, any cloud.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](http://strandsagents.com/): Official website and documentation.
